📋 Export Process

Full service from certification to local delivery

📋
Step 1

Qualification & Certification

Verify export qualification and obtain target country certifications (SONCAP, PVOC, etc.)

🔍
Step 2

Vehicle Sourcing & Inspection

Source vehicles from verified suppliers, conduct thorough inspection and battery health check

🚢
Step 3

Shipping & Customs

Arrange RoRo or container shipping, handle export/import customs clearance

🤝
Step 4

Delivery & After-Sales

Local partner delivery, spare parts supply, and after-sales support

📜 Certification

African countries have strict certification requirements. Shipping without certification results in cargo seizure at port.
